No edit owed under this rule; whether 'a second skill' is the accurate NAME for M6's actual handoff-prompt deliverable is a check_writing.md accuracy question, out of this class's lane (see notes). New content (chunk 42's added M5 hooks index '§§ 34-37') is itself a forward content-ordinal, not a backward beat claim, and resolves in-file (see rule 11).

The one plausible candidate is fixed by this diff: chunk 27 previously carried only a '**Prompt**' label plus an exempt fence; it now opens with a full sentence (L395: 'Have the agent find the last session's transcript, read it, and check its story against git:') that states what the prompt does before the fence — a self-carrying claim, not a bare label. Re-read all 43 chunks; shortest remaining is chunk 19 (Routines, 322-325, 125 words) which still carries a full claim set (invocation syntax, GitHub-repo requirement, in/out-of-scope call). No chunk is a bare wait-state or single context-dependent bullet.
